title: Record the one-coset orbit deficiency budget
body:
## Summary
- Nine weight orbits and one hundred forbidden pair profiles each have scalar rank 8, so a compatible pair cannot carry one of those profiles.
- Nine explicit column shifts have distinct supports and deficiency sum 9, which meets the one-coset budget.
- Partial, no new kappa. This records that budget. It does not exhaust the character pairs.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/one-coset-orbit-budget/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/one-coset-orbit-budget/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/one-coset-orbit-budget`
